title: Tonight, Austin. Tomorrow, OKC.
excerpt: We had great book tour events in Denver and Phoenix (thanks, hosts and friends there!), and tonight we’re in wonderfully weird Austin. Tomorrow – on to Oklahoma City. It’s not too late for you to come if you’re anywhere in the neighborhood! More here: /archive
